description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure from the paper. It is a publisher/Crossref "Check for updates" badge: a circular icon rendered in blue, yellow and red — the ring is split into a blue upper arc, a yellow/amber lower-left arc, and a red central bookmark or shield-shaped motif with a notched (swallow-tail) bottom edge — enclosed within a thin light-grey rounded square frame, with the words "Check for" on one line and "updates" on the next printed in dark grey sans-serif type beneath the icon on a white background. There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no data labels, no curves, no micrograph, no spectra and no tabulated values anywhere in the image. Consequently the image carries zero materials-science information: it does not show any microstructure, diffraction pattern, mechanical property curve, composition, processing condition or measurement relating to the Fe–20Mn–9Al-1.5C lightweight austenitic steel with Ni and Cr additions described in the paper title and abstract. It is an update-notification watermark that appears in the layout adjacent to the article, not an author figure with a number or caption. No scientific claim can be extracted, and none of the caption/reference panel-linking tasks apply. Any downstream agent should treat this item as an artefact of figure routing/cropping rather than as evidence.
